categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: power supply and cloud smart management devices, circuit protection components, and gaming machine touch screens and peripheral equipment. These segments cover manufacturing and sales of electronic protection devices, power distribution units, surge protectors, and specialized gaming display products.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include electronic and mechanical integration, wireless communication, software and firmware development, materials formulation, component design, and manufacturing process integration. Production methods involve surface mount technology (SMT) for miniaturized components, modularization of circuit protection elements, and assembly lines for power and gaming devices with quality control and safety certifications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are in the personal computer, telecommunications, consumer electronics, home appliance, automotive electronics, and gaming industries. The company serves international markets, especially in Europe, America, and Asia, supplying components to downstream manufacturers, distributors, and gaming operators.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in Taiwan with manufacturing facilities in Taipei and Dongguan, China. Its sales markets are global, with significant revenue from Europe, the Americas, and other regions. It actively pursues expansion in overseas markets and international customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the electronics supply chain, manufacturing key components such as power management devices and circuit protection elements. It supplies these to downstream manufacturers and system integrators in various electronic and gaming industries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing core technologies, expanding product lines into new application areas such as green energy management and automotive power supplies, and developing high-value, multifunctional, miniaturized circuit protection components. The company invests significantly in R&D (over 7% of revenue) to innovate smart power systems, IoT devices, and advanced gaming touch screens.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of electronic components and devices. The company also derives income from equity-method investments in subsidiaries. Sales are mostly direct to manufacturers and distributors in the electronics and gaming sectors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with major European and American manufacturers in power and protection device markets. It differentiates itself through rapid product development, comprehensive safety certifications, and strong customer relationships. In the gaming equipment segment, it holds a competitive position by providing customized, high-quality solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In the reported year, the company achieved consolidated revenue of approximately NT$591 million with a net profit of about NT$4.4 million. Revenue slightly declined by 1.43% compared to the prior year, while net profit decreased by 26.48%. The company maintains a solid financial structure with low debt ratios and continues to invest in R&D to drive future growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, reliable, and certified products tailored to customer specifications, supported by strong R&D capabilities and rapid development cycles. It offers integrated solutions combining electronic, mechanical, and software technologies, providing customers with comprehensive power management and circuit protection systems. Its commitment to innovation, quality certifications, and customer service fosters long-term partnerships and competitive advantage.
